name: Test All Container Connectivity
description: Verify all 4 devbob containers can execute remote tasks via ACP delegation

prompt.template:
Create a file /workspace/test-coordinator.txt with content:

Container: Coordinator (Host)
Status: Active
Timestamp: {{timestamp}}

Use the bash tool to create this file.

You are executing in devbob-opencode-agent container.

Create a file /workspace/test-opencode.txt with content:

Container: devbob-opencode-agent
Repository: metabob-opencode
Status: Connected
Timestamp: [current time]

Use the bash tool. Verify with pwd and hostname commands.

You are executing in devbob-rpc-api container.

Create a file /workspace/test-api.txt with content:

Container: devbob-rpc-api
Repository: metabob-api
Status: Connected
Timestamp: [current time]

Use the bash tool. Verify with pwd and hostname commands.

You are executing in devbob-cli-agent container.

Create a file /workspace/test-cli.txt with content:

Container: devbob-cli-agent
Repository: metabob-cli
Status: Connected
Timestamp: [current time]

Use the bash tool. Verify with pwd and hostname commands.

You are executing in devbob-dashboard-agent container.

Create a file /workspace/test-dashboard.txt with content:

Container: devbob-dashboard-agent
Repository: metabob-dashboard
Status: Connected
Timestamp: [current time]

Use the bash tool. Verify with pwd and hostname commands.

tasks.description: Verify all containers created their test files

prompt.template:
Verify that all 5 test files were created successfully:

1. Local: /workspace/test-coordinator.txt
2. OpenCode: check with docker exec devbob-opencode-agent cat /workspace/test-opencode.txt
3. API: check with docker exec devbob-rpc-api cat /workspace/test-api.txt
4. CLI: check with docker exec devbob-cli-agent cat /workspace/test-cli.txt
5. Dashboard: check with docker exec devbob-dashboard-agent cat /workspace/test-dashboard.txt

Create /workspace/container-test-summary.txt with:
- Total containers tested: 5
- Successful connections: [count]
- Failed connections: [count]
- List of successful containers
- List of failed containers (if any)

If all 5 files exist, report SUCCESS for all containers.
